core: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in branching organ morphogenesis
name: Lung and airway epithelial-mesenchymal morphogenesis
rationale: Members are epithelial-mesenchymal interactions driving lung branching, pneumocyte, trachea and lung mesenchyme development plus related bud and palate/salivary morphogenesis, whereas confusables centre on pancreatic, kidney or prostate epithelia.

name: Monocyte recruitment and endothelial adhesion in inflammation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte activation, chemotaxis, aggregation and leukocyte adhesion to and extravasation through endothelium in inflammatory settings (RAGE, inflammatory response), distinguishing it from confusables focused on CCR2/CX3CR1 chemotaxis, monocyte surface identity or myeloid chemokine output.

qualifier: NTRK2 (TrkB) activated by BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4
name: BDNF-NTRK2 (TrkB) neurotrophin receptor signaling
rationale: All members are TrkB activation by its ligands and its downstream RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, FRS2, CDK5 and RAC1 branches, unlike confusables built on TRKA, NTRK3 or NMDA-driven synaptic plasticity.

qualifier: decidualization and endoreduplicating trophoblast giant cells
name: Decidualization and trophoblast giant cell endoreduplication
rationale: Members cover uterine decidualization, embryonic pregnancy processes and endoreduplicative trophoblast giant cell differentiation, distinct from germ cell, labyrinth trophoblast, ovarian cycle and maternal-to-zygotic confusables.

name: Ribonucleotide phosphorylation and inositol pyrophosphate metabolism
rationale: Members interconvert nucleoside mono-, di- and triphosphates (ADP, GDP, GTP) and handle pyrophosphate-containing inositol and diadenosine polyphosphates, unlike confusables on creatine/mitochondrial adenine transport, nuclear PIPs or deoxynucleotide synthesis.

name: RUNX1-regulated myeloid progenitor and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members govern myeloid progenitor fate choice with emphasis on megakaryocyte development and platelet formation under RUNX1 control, while confusables are erythroid-terminal or monocyte-network focused.

name: CFTR trafficking and epithelial anion-water transport
rationale: Members concern CFTR delivery to the membrane, anion transport and transepithelial water movement and basolateral secretion, distinguishing it from confusables on apical raft localization, glandular secretion or TRP/K+ channels.

qualifier: death receptor caspase-8 apoptosis and RIPK1 necroptosis
name: Death receptor caspase-8 apoptosis and RIPK1 necroptosis
rationale: Members are Fas/TRAIL/TLR3-TRIF death signaling via caspase-8, c-FLIP and BID plus RIPK1 necroptosis, unlike confusables on intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis, execution-phase DNA fragmentation or T cell/hepatocyte apoptosis regulation.

qualifier: radiation-induced G2 checkpoint with p53 stabilization
name: Radiation-induced G2 DNA damage checkpoint and p53 stabilization
rationale: Members link gamma-radiation response and G2 checkpoint signaling to TP53 phosphorylation and degradation control, whereas confusables add COP1/Cdc25A degradation and p53 target transcription.

qualifier: transcriptional control restraining granulocyte and monocyte fates
name: Transcriptional control of granulocyte-monocyte progenitor differentiation
rationale: Members are transcriptional programs (granulopoiesis, VENTX, RA/WNT/CSF network, promyelocyte module) and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, lacking the megakaryocyte/erythroid content and the pro-monocyte/dendritic GM-CSF content of confusables.

qualifier: actin remodeling of the phagocytic cup
name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytic cup actin remodeling
rationale: All members describe receptor-triggered phagocytosis via FCGR3A and actin dynamics forming the phagocytic cup, unlike confusables on inhibitory Fc signaling, lamellipodia or ADCC.

name: Endocardial cushion EMT and cardiac valve morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endocardial differentiation, cushion epithelial-mesenchymal transition and fusion, and formation of all four valves, whereas confusables concern myocardium, septa, trabeculae and coronary vessels.

name: Gonadotropin-regulated gonad development, folliculogenesis and ovulation
rationale: Members tie gonadotropin hormones and their receptors to follicle growth, ovulation, luteinization, estrous cycle, Sertoli/Leydig development and germ cell meiosis, while confusables emphasise activin/AMH signaling or oocyte maturation control.

qualifier: biogenic amine degradation and organic cation transport
name: Biogenic amine and organic cation catabolism and transport
rationale: Members degrade monoamines via MAO/COMT and handle choline, carnitine, trimethylamine and SLC organic cation transport, distinguishing it from confusables built on catecholamine and serotonin biosynthesis.

name: Centriole duplication, centrosome maturation and spindle positioning
rationale: Members regulate centriole duplication, mitotic centrosome protein recruitment (PLK1, AURKA-TPX2, NuMA) and spindle assembly and orientation, unlike confusables on cilia, cytokinesis/kinetochore events or interphase MTOC anchoring.

name: Enhanced cellular glucose import and adiponectin secretion
rationale: Members promote glucose import and adiponectin secretion, whereas confusables cover insulin receptor signaling attenuation, GLUT4 translocation machinery or glycogen and glucokinase control.

name: Renal urate transport and hypouricemia
rationale: All members concern urate metabolism and SLC2A9/SLC22A12 urate transport defects causing renal hypouricemia, distinct from cystine, hexose, pentose or drug-transporter confusables.

name: Embryonic head, face and cranial skeleton morphogenesis
rationale: Members are anterior head, face, nose, neurocranium and viscerocranium morphogenesis, without the palate, pharyngeal gland, limb or inner ear content of confusables.

name: mRNA 3'-end cleavage, polyadenylation and histone stem-loop processing
rationale: Members cover cleavage and polyadenylation, Pol II termination and SLBP-dependent/independent histone pre-mRNA 3'-end processing, unlike confusables on mRNA decay, snRNA/spliceosome or mRNA export.

name: Trans-Golgi to endosome and lysosome vesicle trafficking
rationale: Members are Golgi-derived vesicle biogenesis and transport to endosomes and lysosomes with endosomal fusion and secretion, whereas confusables emphasise retrograde endosome-to-Golgi, intra-Golgi or COPI traffic.

qualifier: glucagon, somatostatin and fatty-acid sensing receptors
name: Glucagon, somatostatin and fatty-acid sensing GPCR signaling
rationale: Members are G protein-coupled receptor signaling for glucagon-family, somatostatin, free fatty acid and hydroxycarboxylic acid ligands acting on adenylate cyclase and growth hormone secretion, distinct from calcitonin/amylin or insulin-secretion confusables.

qualifier: FMO/CYP oxidation, sulfonation and acetylation of xenobiotics and phytochemicals
name: Xenobiotic and phytochemical detoxification by oxidation, sulfonation, acetylation
rationale: Members describe phase I/II detoxification of xenobiotics, toxins and plant-derived compounds by FMO and CYP oxidation, sulfonation and acetylation, while confusables add methylation, CYP2E1, aflatoxin or drug ADME.

name: T cell costimulation and CD8/gamma-delta differentiation
rationale: Members are T cell signaling, costimulation and differentiation including CD8 and gamma-delta subsets, unlike confusables on IL-2/IL-7 cytokine signaling, thymocyte/B cell modules or proximal TCR phosphorylation.

qualifier: structural protein maturation and assembly rather than entry
name: Viral structural protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: Members are host-mediated maturation of coronavirus, RSV and dengue structural proteins and assembly at budding sites, whereas confusables are dominated by viral attachment and entry.

name: Ephrin, L1 and DCC axon guidance signaling
rationale: Members combine ephrin-EPH repulsion, L1 signaling and recycling, netrin-DCC attraction and commissural pathfinding, distinct from confusables centred on ROBO-SLIT, netrin repulsion or CHL1/DSCAM.
